text:
Predicates:
RosesGivenOutOnTV(x) ::: roses are given out on TV at time x
OnMondayAt8PM(x) ::: x is on Monday at 8 pm
GivenOut(x) ::: x is given out on TV
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor
PortraysRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show
BreakingBad(x) ::: x is Breaking Bad
Show(x) ::: x is a TV show
Premises:
∀x (RosesGivenOutOnTV(x) → GivenOut(x)) ::: Roses are given out on TV at some times
∀x (GivenOut(x) ∧ OnMondayAt8PM(x) → RosesGivenOutOnTV(x)) ::: Roses are given out on TV at 8 pm on some Mondays
∀x (GivenOut(x) ∧ OnMondayAt8PM(x) → OnBachelor(x)) ::: If roses are given out on TV at 8 pm on Monday, they are on the Bachelor
∀x (OnBachelor(x) → PortraysRealPeople(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people
∀x (PortraysRealPeople(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: Shows portraying real people are reality TV shows
¬RealityTVShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show
Conclusion:
∃x (RosesGivenOutOnTV(x) ∧ OnMondayAt8PM(x)) ::: Roses are given out on TV on some Monday at 8 pm
